name: @plusguard/loading-progress
description: A thin loading bar along the top of the page, as YouTube shows: from the first paint, on every page change, and for your own jobs — filling only once the page is ready, skeletons gone. HTML attributes for timing, for Next and static sites alike. Zero dependencies. CSS included.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
